newsitem.title: USA: American Business says to acquire DBA.
newsitem.headline: American Business says to acquire DBA.

text.p: American Business Information Inc said it signed a letter of intent to acquire DBA Holdings Inc, parent of Database America Cos Inc, a marketing data processing firm.
American Business will use cash and common shares in the transaction, expected to close on January 31, subject to completion of a definitive agreement and regulatory approval.
The transaction, excluding transaction related charges, is expected to be non-dilutive to 1997 earnings, said American Business, a business information concern.
